programme.title: Biblical Collectors Series
programme.desc: Against all odds Israel scored a decisive military victory during the 1967 Six-Day War. How was this possible? Was this one in a series of events foretelling the End Times? Stories abound of the appearance of mysterious troops and sophisticated weaponry that aided the Israelis in their victory. Was the outcome of this conflict foretold by biblical writings thousands of years earlier?

programme.title: Biblical Collectors Series
programme.desc: Two of the world's great religions, Christianity and Judaism, base many of their most important beliefs on declarations made to Moses atop Mt. Sinai. Are the miraculous stories attributed to Moses factual? Did Moses receive the Ten Commandments from God?

programme.title: Jesus The Desire Of Ages
programme.desc: Jesus: The Desire of Ages tells the familiar story in a fresh way, through the eyes of those who knew and loved the Son of Man. An inspiring and triumphant music score combined with imaginative visual artistry will grip your heart as you experience the reality of Jesus' ultimate sacrifice.

programme.title: The Twelve Apostles: The First 12 Men Chosen By Jesus
programme.desc: The Galilean fishmonger, Peter, emerged as pre-eminent amongst the apostles. We look at his controversial life and career ending with his martyrdom in Rome and his place in laying the foundation of the Catholic Church.

programme.title: Ancient Secrets of the Bible
programme.desc: The Bible is silent about Jesus' life from the ages of 2 to 12 and 13 to 30. Are these silent early years of Jesus really lost? The answers may surprise you!

programme.title: Tomb of Jesus: The Evidence
programme.desc: The Real Discoveries team visit two tombs each believed to be the tombs where Jesus was laid to rest and later rose. However, Jesus could not have been laid and risen from both tombs. Is there any evidence to support the fact that either of these sites is the genuine one? Find out as we journey to discover the Tomb of Jesus!

programme.title: Charlton Heston Presents The Bible (Widescreen)
programme.desc: Never-before-seen documentary footage takes you on an amazing adventure behind the scenes, to see first-hand how this epic multi-national production was filmed on the very ground where it happened From the Creation to the Resurrection, Heston captures the passion of the Bible through the power of the spoken word, the way its mysteries and legends were originally passed down for generations.

programme.title: Tomb of Jesus: The Evidence
programme.desc: The Real Discoveries team visit two tombs each believed to be the tombs where Jesus was laid to rest and later rose. However, Jesus could not have been laid and risen from both tombs. Is there any evidence to support the fact that either of these sites is the genuine one? Find out as we journey to discover the Tomb of Jesus!

programme.title: Come Follow Me
programme.desc: Come Follow Me dramatizes the relationship between Jesus and the Apostle Peter. From the day Peter heard Jesus call his name to the post-resurrection conversation in which Jesus charges Peter to 'feed my sheep,' this short film beautifully illustrates Peter's transformation from fearful denier to the bold leader of the early church.

programme.title: The Last Hours of Jesus Christ
programme.desc: From his arrest to his resurrection, a lot of questions still surround the last hours of Jesus' life. Recent discoveries and eXperts' analysis shed some light on this enigma. Did Jesus really dies on the cross? Follow this investigation on one of History's biggest mysteries.

programme.title: The Savior
programme.desc: The story of the Man, His times, and His message. Taken directly from the Gospel of Luke and filmed in Israel and Palestine.

programme.title: The Tomb of Jesus
programme.desc: The Real Discoveries team visit two tombs each believed to be the tombs where Jesus was laid to rest and later rose. However, Jesus could not have been laid and risen from both tombs. Is there any evidence to support the fact that either of these sites is the genuine one? Find out as we journey to discover the Tomb of Jesus!

programme.title: Jesus
programme.desc: This production aims to stimulate interest on the part of a Biblically illiterate generation to want to know more about the Gospels and the extraordinary life, death, resurrection and meaning of Jesus.

programme.title: Jesus The Desire Of Ages
programme.desc: Jesus: The Desire of Ages tells the familiar story in a fresh way, through the eyes of those who knew and loved the Son of Man. An inspiring and triumphant music score combined with imaginative visual artistry will grip your heart as you experience the reality of Jesus' ultimate sacrifice.

programme.title: Twelve Ordinary Men
programme.desc: A look at the twelve disciples who were hand-picked by Jesus to learn from his teachings, and spread the gospel after his crucifixion. Why these men?

programme.title: Prophecies of the Passion
programme.desc: Prophecies of the Passion is an extraordinary look at the Messianic prophecies fulfilled during the final week of Christ's life on earth. The Gospels clearly describe Jesus' betrayal, arrest, death, and resurrection. Remarkably, these events were foretold by Hebrew prophets-in specific detail... centuries before they actually occurred.

programme.title: Ancient Secrets of the Bible
programme.desc: An investigation into the identity of Mary Magdalene, one the Bible's best known women, produces startling insights. Who was she? A fallen woman rescued by Jesus or Christ's beloved disciple?

programme.title: The Twelve Apostles: The First 12 Men Chosen By Jesus
programme.desc: Judas has been the symbol of evil and treachery but does he deserve this reputation? Why has he continued to fascinate writers, actors and artists? It is time to re-examine his role in the Jesus story and in the centuries that followed.

programme.title: Mystery of the Shroud
programme.desc: In a tomb located in Jerusalem's Hell Valley, on land bought with Judas Iscariot's bloodstained silver, a sensational discovery was made. Vital information has been uncovered to paint a picture of what Jesus' grave would have looked like and what his burial process involved. One of the key moments in Christian history is made real and contemporary through this exciting archaeological discovery.

programme.title: The Living Bible Series
programme.desc: The Gospels include eight pre-resurrection accounts concerning Jesus' power over nature.

programme.title: Ancient Secrets of the Bible
programme.desc: The Bible is silent about Jesus' life from the ages of 2 to 12 and 13 to 30. Are these silent early years of Jesus really lost? The answers may surprise you!

programme.title: Charlton Heston Presents The Bible (Widescreen)
programme.desc: The tragedy and victory of the New Testament. Follow Jesus through the Last Supper, His betrayal by Judas in Gethsemane, His trial before Pilate and the crowds, His Crucifixion, and the joyful triumph of His Resurrection and Ascension. He is Risen.

programme.title: Ancient Secrets of the Bible
programme.desc: Is it the cloth that covered Jesus in the tomb? A silent witness to the greatest event in history? What are its secrets? New evidence reveals the truth.

programme.title: Third Day
programme.desc: On the third day after Jesus' crucifixion, eyewitnesses reported that they found an empty tomb and had an encounter with a living, breathing Jesus of Nazareth. What proof do we have that the resurrection really happened? This intriguing documentary digs deep into the biblical and historical accounts and explores these questions: Did the disciples steal the body?

programme.title: Path Of The Wind
programme.desc: As an ex-convict, Lee Ferguson's biggest desire is to leave his past behind and make a fresh start with Katie, his new love. But when Lee finds out Katie is a Christian, his pre-conceived ideas and her moral standards clash. Through engaging action and drama, this film explores temptation, sin, forgiveness and redemption, while helping seekers and believers understand one another!

programme.title: My Son My Savior
programme.desc: From the makers of the award winning biblical dramas, Road to Emmaus and Come Follow Me, comes My Son, My Savior, a powerful portrayal of the life of Jesus as seen through the eyes of his mother, Mary.

programme.title: Ancient Secrets of the Bible
programme.desc: The Bible is silent about Jesus' life from the ages of 2 to 12 and 13 to 30. Are these silent early years of Jesus really lost? The answers may surprise you!

programme.title: Joseph: Beloved Son, Rejected Slave, Exalted Ruler
programme.desc: The thrilling Biblical story of Joseph is told in this high quality 3-D animated feature film for children ages 5 and up.

programme.title: The Shroud: Face to Face
programme.desc: Robert Orlando's documentary portrays Jesus' crucifixion as a transformative true crime story. It uses New Testament insights, expert interviews, and digital recreations to examine the Shroud of Turin. Bloodstains align with gospel accounts, suggesting authenticity. Orlando hopes to renew interest in Christian history.

programme.title: Chasing Revival
programme.desc: Our road trip Bible study truly begins with one Man, Jesus Christ, and in one city, Jerusalem.

programme.title: The Living Bible Series
programme.desc: Joseph is reunited with his father and brothers.

programme.title: Birth of Christianity
programme.desc: In the first years, why did James, referred to as the 'brother of the Lord,' appear to be the veritable successor to Jesus? Did Jesus have brothers? Why do some of the Gospels proclaim the virginity of Mary, Jesus' mother? Why did his family believe that Jesus was 'crazy?' Were his mother and his brother opposed to the group of twelve disciples?

programme.title: The Fourth Wiseman
programme.desc: Based on Henry van Dyke's classic, The Story of the Other Wise Man, this fictional story set in Biblical times is told in gently comic terms. A Magi named Artaban (Martin Sheen) sees a sign in the heavens that he hopes will lead him to the Messiah. Artaban takes with him three precious gifts to present to the Messiah. For 33 years Artaban pursues Jesus, only to miss Him at every turn.

programme.title: Ancient Secrets of the Bible
programme.desc: Two thousand years ago Jesus Christ was born. Did He really exist? Experience the joy and wonder of those who witnessed the Christmas miracle - the birth of Jesus Christ.

programme.title: A Moment in History
programme.desc: Seth explores the final 24 hours in the life of Jesus Christ.

programme.title: The Living Bible Series
programme.desc: In Christian theology the nativity marks the birth of Jesus in fulfillment of the divine will of God, to save the world from sin. John used baptism as the central symbol or sacrament of his messianic movement. John baptized Jesus.

programme.title: Biblical Collectors Series
programme.desc: Who was Mary Magdalene? A fallen woman rescued by Jesus or was she Christ's beloved disciple. An investigation into the mystery surrounding her identity produces startling insights. What message did the Virgin Mary bring to Fatima and reveal in 1917? A prophecy from biblical times? Learn the surprising answer.

programme.title: The Last Hours of Jesus Christ
programme.desc: From his arrest to his resurrection, a lot of questions still surround the last hours of Jesus' life. Recent discoveries and eXperts' analysis shed some light on this enigma. Did Jesus really dies on the cross? Follow this investigation on one of History's biggest mysteries.

For 33 years Artaban pursues Jesus, only to miss Him at every turn.

programme.title: Charlton Heston Presents The Bible (Widescreen)
programme.desc: The life, ministry and message of Jesus Christ. Here is the story of His humble birth in a Bethlehem manger, His baptism in the River Jordan and of His calling of the disciples. Witness Jesus' temptation in the wilderness, the Sermon on the Mount, the healing of the blind and many miracles.

programme.title: Ancient Secrets of the Bible

programme.desc: The thrilling Biblical story of Joseph is told in this high quality 3-D animated feature film for children ages 5 and up.

programme.title: Biblical Collectors Series
programme.desc: Even the Bible is silent about Jesus' life from the ages of 2 to 12 and 13 to 30. Will an investigation into these so-called silent early years reveal that Jesus was aware of His own divinity . . . even as a child? Why is the record of most of His life missing? Are the so-called silent early years of Jesus really lost? Or has the truth never been told? The answers you'll find here may surprise you!

programme.title: A Moment in History

programme.title: The Last Hours of Jesus Christ
programme.desc: From his arrest to his resurrection, a lot of questions still surround the last hours of Jesus' life. Recent discoveries and eXperts' analysis shed some light on this enigma. Did Jesus really dies on the cross? Follow this investigation on one of History's biggest mysteries.

programme.title: Chasing Revival
programme.desc: Our road trip Bible study truly begins with one Man, Jesus Christ, and in one city, Jerusalem.

programme.title: Ancient Secrets of the Bible
programme.desc: In 1917, two little girls and one small boy claimed to see and hear the Virgin Mary near Fatima, Portugal. What did the Fatima children witness? Learn the surprising answers.

programme.title: Jesus
programme.desc: This production aims to stimulate interest on the part of a Biblically illiterate generation to want to know more about the Gospels and the extraordinary life, death, resurrection and meaning of Jesus.

programme.title: Jesus and the Early Church
programme.desc: John was called by Jesus from the shores of the Sea of Galilee to come and follow him. For 3 years he was one of the inner-band of disciples, witnessing the transfiguration. After the death of Jesus, he was first at the tomb to discover that Jesus had risen. He became leader of the church at Ephesus where he wrote the Gospel of John. In the mines of Patmos, he had a wonderful vision of God.

programme.title: Scarlet Woman: The True Story of Mary Magdalene
programme.desc: Mary Magdalene is a familiar presence in modern culture. We've read about her in the Da Vinci Code. We've heard about her in Jesus Christ Superstar. We think we know the story well. Yet in actual fact we don't know it at all because it's all a fantasy. For a thousand years, the Mary Magdalene story has been one of art's most tremulous myths. In the Bible, she warrants just four actual mentions.

programme.title: The Week That Changed The World
programme.desc: The resurrection happened. It's not just the belief of Christians, it's borne out by history, archaeology, and science. This documentary takes viewers step by step through the events of Holy Week-shedding light on the key players, unraveling the political intrigue, and answering long standing questions about what happened, and why. Professor of ancient history and world-renowned expert Dr. Paul L.

programme.title: Charlton Heston Presents The Bible (Widescreen)
programme.desc: The life, ministry and message of Jesus Christ. Here is the story of His humble birth in a Bethlehem manger, His baptism in the River Jordan and of His calling of the disciples. Witness Jesus' temptation in the wilderness, the Sermon on the Mount, the healing of the blind and many miracles.

programme.title: I Believe In Easter
programme.desc: Learn how the church adapted and transformed pagan tradition into the celebration of the Resurrection. See how culture, emperors, apostles and popes have influenced how we celebrate Easter today.

programme.title: Jesus and the Early Church
programme.desc: James and Jude were the brothers of Jesus, who like Jesus, grew up in their father's carpenters shop in Nazareth. It was only after Jesus' death and resurrection that they became his followers, with James heading up the Jerusalem Church. Each of them wrote letters to the believers with James encouraging them to do good deeds as well as believe.

programme.title: The Living Bible Series
programme.desc: The Last Supper is the final meal that, in the Gospel accounts, Jesus shared with his Apostles in Jerusalem before his crucifixion.

programme.title: My Son My Savior
programme.desc: From the makers of the award winning biblical dramas, Road to Emmaus and Come Follow Me, comes My Son, My Savior, a powerful portrayal of the life of Jesus as seen through the eyes of his mother, Mary.

programme.title: Biblical Collectors Series
programme.desc: Who was Mary Magdalene? A fallen woman rescued by Jesus or was she Christ's beloved disciple. An investigation into the mystery surrounding her identity produces startling insights. What message did the Virgin Mary bring to Fatima and reveal in 1917? A prophecy from biblical times? Learn the surprising answer.

programme.title: Discovering Apostle Paul
programme.desc: Paul's background gave him a good understanding of Greek culture and philosophies. But to him the Gospel wasn't philosophy, it was truth and unlike the monasteries of Meteora, where monks hid their faith away, Paul engaged with the philosophers of his day in the market place. In Athens he was invited to address the Council of the Areopagus about the resurrection and 'Unknown God'.

programme.title: The Twelve Apostles: The First 12 Men Chosen By Jesus
programme.desc: From very early on, Mary was given the title 'Apostle of the Apostles'. We follow her career as a close follower of Jesus and, contrary to popular belief, show how she is a role model for the Christian life and a powerful feminist voice.

programme.title: A Moment in History
programme.desc: Seth explores the final 24 hours in the life of Jesus Christ.

programme.title: Jesus and the Early Church
programme.desc: St Peter's Basilica in Rome is the centre of the Roman Catholic faith. But the man who it is named after, knew nothing but fishing for the first part of his life. Following the death and resurrection of Jesus, Peter became a missionary of the Christian Church. From the shores of the Sea of Galilee to the might of Rome, Peter became one of the young churches first missionaries.

programme.title: The Case for Christ
programme.desc: Lee Strobel's blockbuster bestseller comes alive on your screen in this documentary that chronicles the reporter's journey from atheism to faith. The former legal editor of the Chicago Tribune draws upon his investigative skills to examine the historical viability and accuracy of the Gospels, along with the personal claims and resurrection of Jesus Christ.

programme.title: Herod's Temple: The Temple Jesus Knew
programme.desc: Jerusalem, rich in historical and Biblical heritage, is the home of the Temple Mount, one of the world's most recognizable and visited sacred sites. Now, travel back in time to see it the way Jesus and his disciples did over 2,000 years ago. They knew it as Herod's Temple. We remember it as the Temple Jesus knew.

programme.title: The Twelve Apostles: The First 12 Men Chosen By Jesus
programme.desc: The Galilean fishmonger, Peter, emerged as pre-eminent amongst the apostles. We look at his controversial life and career ending with his martyrdom in Rome and his place in laying the foundation of the Catholic Church.

programme.title: Jeremy's Egg
programme.desc: Twelve-year-old Jeremy is terminally ill and the only special-needs child in second grade. One day his teacher gives her students plastic eggs with the instructions to fill them with something that symbolizes Easter and new life.

programme.title: The Shroud: Face to Face
programme.desc: Robert Orlando's documentary portrays Jesus' crucifixion as a transformative true crime story. It uses New Testament insights, expert interviews, and digital recreations to examine the Shroud of Turin. Bloodstains align with gospel accounts, suggesting authenticity. Orlando hopes to renew interest in Christian history.

programme.title: The Case for Christ
programme.desc: Lee Strobel's blockbuster bestseller comes alive on your screen in this documentary that chronicles the reporter's journey from atheism to faith. programme.title: The Living Bible Series
programme.desc: The Gospels include eight pre-resurrection accounts concerning Jesus' power over nature.

programme.title: The Savior
programme.desc: The story of the Man, His times, and His message. Taken directly from the Gospel of Luke and filmed in Israel and Palestine.

programme.title: Come Follow Me
programme.desc: Come Follow Me dramatizes the relationship between Jesus and the Apostle Peter. From the day Peter heard Jesus call his name to the post-resurrection conversation in which Jesus charges Peter to 'feed my sheep,' this short film beautifully illustrates Peter's transformation from fearful denier to the bold leader of the early church.

programme.title: Ancient Secrets of the Bible
programme.desc: Is it the cloth that covered Jesus in the tomb? A silent witness to the greatest event in history? What are its secrets? New evidence reveals the truth.

programme.title: Carry Me Home
programme.desc: Carry Me Home is a short film following the true story of Maria Ennals (Lindsey Grimble) and her family in the Antebellum South in the cold winter of 1860. Maria is a young mother trapped in slavery who seizes the opportunity to escape with her family when she encounters HARRIET TUBMAN (Karen Abercrombie, War Room).

programme.title: Path Of The Wind
programme.desc: As an ex-convict, Lee Ferguson's biggest desire is to leave his past behind and make a fresh start with Katie, his new love. But when Lee finds out Katie is a Christian, his pre-conceived ideas and her moral standards clash. Through engaging action and drama, this film explores temptation, sin, forgiveness and redemption, while helping seekers and believers understand one another!

programme.title: Esther
programme.desc: Following the conquest of Babylon, the King of Persia gives a banquet for his people, but his wife, Vashti, refuses to attend. Ahasuerus disowns Vashti and goes in search of her replacement. In his harem, he meets the young girl Esther and falls in love with her. Esther then reveals to Ahasuerus that she is Jewish and asks him to show her people mercy.

programme.title: Wesley: A Heart Transformed Can Change the World
programme.desc: John Wesley is well known as the spiritual father of Methodism. His heartfelt struggles, his passion for authentic faith expressing itself through meaningful kingdom work, and his message of saving grace resonate with audiences of all ages and denominations.

programme.title: Heavens to Betsy
programme.desc: All Betsy Simon wanted was a little success. An aspiring author of children's books featuring her cat, 'Wishes,' Betsy believes she is about to get her big break. But when she is turned down by a major book publisher, Betsy is devastated. Starring newcomer Karen Lesiewicz and featuring Emmy-Winning actor, Jim O'Heir (Parks and Recreation).

programme.title: Newton's Grace
programme.desc: Newton's Grace is the true story of a real 'Prodigal Son,' the story of miraculous forgiveness and change that lies behind the powerful words of one of the world's most beloved hymns.

programme.title: Inheritance
programme.desc: When the family patriarch dies suddenly, the Delvecchio's are thrown into crisis. Family secrets and simmering feuds between brothers, fathers and sons threaten to undo the family until God intervenes.

programme.title: We are Stronger
programme.desc: We Are Stronger is a faith-based film exploring a veteran's battle with PTSD. While Vic struggles to recover from his physical injuries, reclaim his marriage, and adjust to life after combat, he discovers he can't do it alone. Made in cooperation with the Stronger Alliance, Mighty Oaks, CRU Military, Amos House of Faith, Armed Forces Mission, and more who are dedicated to trauma recovery.

programme.title: Find Me
programme.desc: This moving, personal documentary tells the stories of those who adopt children from China as well as the stories of those who loved them first; The biological parents who feel they can't keep their children and the orphanage nannies or foster-families who must say goodbye to the children they've raised for months.

programme.title: Corrie ten Boom: A Faith Undefeated
programme.desc: When Nazi forces invaded Holland in 1940 and began rounding up Jews, Corrie ten Boom, her sister Betsie, and their elderly father risked their lives to save as many as possible. A hidden room was secretly built in their home where the oppressed Jews took refuge until a Gestapo raid put an end to their operation. Corrie ten Boom.

programme.title: A Christmas Village
programme.desc: To save her reputation, Piper Jensen, a public relations genius and owner of her own PR company, agrees to work for the owner of a failing Santa's Village and discovers love and how magical Christmas is after all.

programme.title: Heavens to Betsy 2
programme.desc: Author Betsy Simon (Karen Lesiewicz) finally finds career success when her new novel, Heavens to Betsy, is published. Following advice from her agent (Ruth Kaufman), she tells the public that the book is a work of fiction. After talking with Pastor John (Jim O'Heir from TV's 'Parks and Recreation') she claims that the events portrayed in the book actually happened to her!

programme.title: Jesus
programme.desc: This production aims to stimulate interest on the part of a Biblically illiterate generation to want to know more about the Gospels and the extraordinary life, death, resurrection and meaning of Jesus.

programme.title: Road To Emmaus

programme.title: We Were There
programme.desc: We Were There captures the voices of America's greatest generation, as they share their stories of duty, service, and responsibility during World War II. While the tumultuous global events of the early 1940's provide the backdrop for this film, it is the men and women recalling their personal stories who take center stage.

programme.title: Biblical Prophecy of John - End Times Revelation & Message to the 7 Churches
programme.desc: John's letters to the Seven Churches, written while he was in exile on Patmos, were messages from Jesus to seven churches in Asia Minor. The Seven Churches included: Ephesus, Smyrna, Pergamon, Thyatira, Sardis, Philadelphia, Laodicea . The history/story of each letter is described in this program.

programme.title: Israel, Islam, and Armageddon
programme.desc: With more than 3000 years of history, Jerusalem is mentioned 800 times in the Bible, and prophesied to play a key role in world destiny. Many of these prophecies have already come to pass, with some yet to be fulfilled. This video shows how the current peace process is fraught with peril, why it is impossible for Jerusalem to know true peace in our age, and the Palestinian myth.

programme.title: In The Shadow Of Babylon: Prophecy Revealed
programme.desc: Throughout time the human race has been besieged by an unseen religious force. This program reveals the source of all religious confusion, not only in the obvious cults, sects, denominations, but also in the more subtle tones of Christianity. She how pagan Babylon has infected the world's religions, even to the door of your own church.

This informative documentary explores Bible prophecy surrounding the kingdom of Antichrist by tracking the history of the New World Order from the pages of Scripture to the global revolution sweeping the world.

programme.desc: Against all odds Israel scored a decisive military victory during the 1967 Six-Day War. How was this possible? Was this one in a series of events foretelling the End Times? Stories abound of the appearance of mysterious troops and sophisticated weaponry that aided the Israelis in their victory. Was the outcome of this conflict foretold by biblical writings thousands of years earlier?

programme.desc: Casillas mata a Medardo, y Marcado huye para ayudar al Chema luego de que Tim y Rivero incautan el uranio. Tijeras también escapa, mientras Mónica acepta la condición de Omar.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Leonor golpea a Casillas, lo deja herido y amenaza con matarlo: ahora sabe que sexo y muerte van de la mano. Mónica y Rutila ya tienen su propio negocio.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Casillas busca a Mónica, pero ella lo rechaza y le dice que se aleje de su hijo, mientras el Chema amenaza a Rutila. Tijeras convence a Marcado y se escapan a Colombia en un avión del Chema.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Casillas sorprende a su familia, pero Irma lo acusa de haber entregado a Chacorta a cambio de su libertad. Rutila recibe la carta de Ernesto, mientras el Chema le exige que seduzca a Rivero.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Tim le pide a Casillas que le envíe un cargamento de droga a Chicago, pero él no tiene ni mercancía ni dinero para volver a montar su red de narcotráfico. Leonor ve de nuevo a Ignacio.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Casillas jura ante la tumba de Chacorta que vengará su muerte, y acusa a Irma de ser la culpable por convencerlo de dejar el negocio. Prepara una coartada para llevar a cabo su venganza.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio mata a Irma, y hace ver que murió en el ataque de la Policía y la Marina al rancho de Sinaloa. Logran escapar del tiroteo, pero Chabela queda malherida. Feyo promete enviar la droga.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Víctor llora la muerte de Chabela y de sus hijos, mientras Casillas le plantea la venganza. Tim trata de convencer a Rivero de que Aurelio no estaba en Sinaloa. Leonor busca olvidar a Casillas.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Víctor le dice a Aurelio que acepta entrar en el negocio para vengar la muerte de Chabela y sus hijos, y le entrega el dinero de la venta del ganado. Mónica le exige al Chema que se aleje.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Casillas intenta seducir a la Condesa, quien le coquetea, pero asegura que es fiel a Feyo. Víctor quiere comenzar su venganza y matar al que dio el pitazo de que estaba en el rancho de Sinaloa.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Víctor viaja con Aurelio a Chicago para entregar la droga a Tim, y crecen sus sospechas sobre el Espanto. Rutila visita a Ernesto y le miente, mientras doña Alba la compara con su padre.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: El Chema secuestra a su propio hijo para demostrarle a Rutila que él pone las reglas, mientras su rabia aumenta luego de que el Güero le dice que le hizo una visita conyugal a Ernesto.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: El Chema sigue castigando a Rutila: le dice que tiene que ganarse a su hijo o la madre sustituta lo hará. Garnica recibe el dinero para matar a Ernesto, ahora con el apoyo de Venegas.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio le propone a Feyo una alianza: comprar su finca, pero que, a cambio, lo ayude a matar al Chema. Leonor acusa a Rawlins de utilizar a Aurelio para inundar a Chicago de drogas y llevarse los elogios.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aunque Tim le cambió la pauta, Casillas ordena lanzar granadas a la casa del Chema, pero se entera de que ahí está el hijo de Rutila. Omar está con Mónica y recibe la visita inesperada de Leonor.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Rutila se muda con el Chema para estar con su hijo, luego que Aurelio le echa en cara que quedó embarazada para vengarse. Tim le propone a Rivero dar un golpe con la captura de Víctor.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Mónica cae de nuevo en los brazos de Aurelio, quien le confiesa que planeó el ataque al rancho para salir de Irma, pero también murió Chabela. Marcado y Garnica le tienden una trampa al Chema.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: El Chema escapa del ataque de Marcado. Rutila no se salva y paga las consecuencias. A Marcado no le importa nada, y mata a su propia familia frente a los ojos de la hija de Casillas.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Destrozada, Rutila le cuenta al Chema que Marcado la violó y le echa la culpa. Llama a Aurelio para que la ayude a vengarse, pero Venegas le dice que si habla, no volverá a ver a su hijo.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio se encuentra cara a cara con el Chema y le exige que le devuelva a su nieto, mientras Rutila se desahoga con Víctor y le advierte que ahora los dos enfrentan el odio muy de cerca.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Tim amenaza a Aurelio con detener a su familia, pero los planes de Morejón lo llevan a pactar con él la muerte de su jefe, Jack Meléndez. Rivero desconfía de Rawlings y aún no sabe la verdad.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Rutila, angustiada, se refugia en Aurelio y le cuenta que Marcado la violó; él jura vengarse y rescatar a su hijo. Casillas sorprende a Víctor al pedirle ver a Cristina porque se va a entregar.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio le revela sus secretos a Cristina en una entrevista exclusiva, aunque puede publicarla cuando él diga. Rivero se prepara para capturar a Casillas, pero antes se reúne con Rutila.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio se enfrenta a balazos con Rivero y las tropas de la Marina, y aprovecha el tiroteo para matar a Espanto. Feyo convence al Chema, y con sus hombres llegan para apoyar a Casillas.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: En medio del tiroteo, el Chema le salva la vida a Aurelio, pero le recuerda que tiene en sus manos a su hija y a su nieto. Rivero está al borde de la muerte, mientras don Feyo resulta herido.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: El Chema pacta con Aurelio para levantar el negocio y derrotar a sus enemigos, pero pone como condición que Rutila y su hijo vivan con él. Rivero se salva y acusa a Tim de tenderle una trampa.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio se burla de Tim, y le aclara que ahora no recibe órdenes. Acabará con Meléndez porque ahora es el jefe. Garnica amenaza a Ignacio con las Emes si no lo ayuda a limpiar su expediente.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio le asegura a Javi que no es un soplón. Tim le pide a Julia que convenza a Meléndez de que no vuelva a México, sin sospechar que Casillas y Víctor van a Washington para eliminarlo.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Mónica seduce al Tijeras, y ahora es su representante en Michoacán. Tim está desesperado porque no puede ir a Washington, mientras Rutila enfurece a Rivero al contarle que Marcado la violó.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Mónica interrumpe la reunión de los narcotraficantes para proponer ser intermediaria con los colombianos. Los Casillas asesinan a Meléndez, aunque Julia y Tim trataron de impedirlo.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Furioso porque Mónica se mete en sus asuntos, y luego de una fuerte discusión, Aurelio sufre un infarto. Víctor descubre que Leonor y Omar están en Michoacán, mientras Marcado huye.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Antes de su operación, los familiares de Aurelio llegan a Michoacán, donde la Condesa se encarga de atenderlo. Julia termina con Tim, luego que mintió para no implicarlo en la muerte de Jack.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Mónica enfrenta al Tijeras: le tenderá una trampa a Eleazar y a las Emes. Leonor visita a Feyo en su rancho, sin imaginar que ahí están los Casillas. Tim está bajo sospecha por la muerte de Jack.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio y la Condesa se besan apasionadamente, mientras Mónica reconoce que ha sido su único amor. Julia le dice la verdad a Leonor sobre el asesinato de Jack. Tim le miente a Rivero.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio le pide perdón a Rutila por dejarla sola con el Chema, y por la muerte de Ximena y Heriberto. Ella descubre que él tuvo relaciones con Leo y jura vengar el asesinato de su hermano.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Mónica escucha aterrada que Feyo le pide al médico que deje morir a Aurelio en la operación. Belén niega ser infiel a Aguilera. El Chema está celoso por la relación entre Rutila y Rivero.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Mónica llora ante Feyo y le dice que Aurelio es su gran amor, padre de su hijo, y que su relación está mejor que nunca. Ella le salvó la vida a Casillas, ahora él acepta su condición.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio sale bien de la operación, mientras Mónica advierte a Belén que se aleje de él porque Feyo los mataría a los dos. Víctor le dice a Robles que negociaron con Javi y los venezolanos.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Belén no resiste y hace el amor con Aurelio, mientras Mónica los observa en silencio. Le reclama a los Casillas su negocio con los Soles y la guerrilla. Tijeras está furioso porque no tiene mercancía.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Mónica atormenta a Belén porque se entregó a Aurelio, y le sentencia que su calvario apenas comienza. Casillas quiere volver con Robles, mientras el Chema exige a Rutila que seduzca a Rivero.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Mónica se niega a volver con Aurelio, quien confiesa que siente miedo y culpabilidad por la muerte de la esposa de Víctor. Morejón no acepta el ultimátum que los Emes le enviaron con Ignacio.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio y Tim arreglan sus cuentas a golpes. Rawlings le propone que se convierta en el mayor lavador de dinero del mundo, y también le pide que elimine al Güero, su obstáculo en la DEA.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio se reúne en Panamá con Esperanza, su nueva socia, cuya belleza y audacia lo atrapan. El Güero negocia con Tim: le dice que le irá mejor que con Rivero y le pregunta quién es su protegido.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio cae en los brazos de Esperanza y su amiga. Rivero ordena investigar los negocios de Rutila, mientras ella roba información de su computadora, a pedido del Chema. Omar alerta a Mónica.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio les dice a sus socios que ahora se dedica al lavado de dinero y Víctor queda en su lugar. Por orden de Rivero, allanan el local de Rutila y Mónica, y hallan químicos para fabricar éxtasis.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Víctor se enfrenta a Carreño y mata a uno de sus hombres: jura que eliminará al general venezolano la próxima vez que le diga traidor a su tío. Feyo le confiesa a la Condesa que asesinó a Juan.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Tijeras ataca con una bazuca a Eleazar y al general Jaramillo, y escapa cuando el ejército llega a su finca. Feyo mata a Justino y hace creer que fueron los Emes. Belén lo defiende ante Leonor.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Mónica necesita que Aurelio le consiga la droga para sus socios, pero él le pone como condición que mate al Güero. Andrews le comunica a Tim que queda frente a la DEA y está bajo sus órdenes.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Belén quiere escapar con Aurelio: sabe que Feyo mató a Justino y teme ser la próxima víctima. Los Emes atacan a Feyo, pero él cree que fue Aurelio. Víctor sigue a Mónica hasta la casa de Chema.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Silvestre intenta abusar de Leonor en casa de Elisa, pero Aurelio la salva de nuevo. Ballesteros no dice quién la rescató de las manos del violador. Víctor conoce el plan de Mónica y la sigue.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Secuestran a Luzma y sus amigos, pero Morejón ordena rescatarlos sanos y salvos. Mónica va a casa del Güero para cumplir con el encargo de Aurelio. Antes, Leonor le presenta a Andrews su renuncia.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Víctor ayuda a Mónica con el encargo, y Leonor es la sospechosa de la muerte del Güero. Aurelio culpa a Rutila por el secuestro de Luzma, mientras Ignacio descubre que es hija de Casillas.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Luzma le dice a sus amigos que su papá los va a rescatar, mientras que Morejón se entera de que Luciana es amiga de la hija de Aurelio. Leonor enfrenta a Tim: lo acusa de la muerte del Güero.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Casillas llega al lugar donde mataron a Richie, mientras Luzma ruega a los secuestradores que negocien con su papá. El Chema y el Toro descubren que Julia es la esposa de Tim y deciden matarla.

programme.desc: Luzma le dice a sus amigos que su papá los va a rescatar, mientras que Morejón se entera de que Luciana es amiga de la hija de Aurelio. Leonor enfrenta a Tim: lo acusa de la muerte del Güero.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Casillas llega al lugar donde mataron a Richie, mientras Luzma ruega a los secuestradores que negocien con su papá. El Chema y el Toro descubren que Julia es la esposa de Tim y deciden matarla.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: El secuestrador hace que Marcado vaya por Luzma, a cambio de trabajar con Aurelio. Rutila se entera de que su hermanita consume metanfetaminas. Morejón le pide a Rivero que retome su cargo.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio rescata a Luzma y se enfrenta a Marcado, pero el violador de Rutila escapa. Padre e hija viajan a Michoacán, al rancho de Feyo. Morejón deja en manos de Rivero la rendición de los Emes.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio y Belén se aman con pasión, mientras doña Alba cae en los brazos de Feyo. La hija y el yerno de Aguilera descubren la infidelidad. Morejón se entera de que Casillas liberó a los muchachos.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: El Toro le dispara a Julia, quien muere en los brazos de Tim. Leonor escucha que la asesinaron para vengar al Güero y acusa a Rawlings. Rutila desespera y decide ir a la guerra contra el Chema.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: El Chema impide a la fuerza que Rutila escape con su hijo, mientras Víctor promete no dejar sola a su prima. Feyo y doña Alba siguen juntos, y Luzma le dice a Belén que está enamorada de su papá.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Feyo llega al rancho, y su hija le dice que Belén le monta cuernos con Aurelio. Casillas pide luz verde a Rutila para matar al Chema; también le da pautas a Tim para vengar la muerte de Julia.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Feyo estalla de la rabia; le tiende una trampa a Belén para que vaya a casa de Justino y, delante de Aurelio, la amenaza de muerte. Ignacio le pide ayuda a Leonor para liberar a su asistente.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Feyo degüella y manda a enterrar a Belén ante los ojos de Aurelio, y le exige que pida perdón por ensuciar a la mujer que amaba. Casillas se va con Luzma de Michoacán tras la amenaza de Aguilera.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Mónica le dice a Aurelio que no lo quiere ver más, y él les propone a ella y a Esperanza que hagan una despedida los tres. Feyo dice en su rancho que Belén no regresará y prohíbe hablar de ella.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Morejón tiene problemas de bebida, y su esposa y colaboradores están preocupados. Aurelio sufre un fuerte dolor por deficiencia renal. Mónica negocia con Esperanza a espaldas de Casillas.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Víctor y Mónica hacen el amor; él no olvida a Chabela, pero quiere que lo ayude a no pensar en ella. Aurelio y Tim buscan un culpable del asesinato de Andrews, y Rivero detiene a Leonor.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Cristina, drogada, entra a la fuerza a casa de Víctor, donde Mónica la enfrenta. Furiosa, la periodista le dice a Rutila que se vengará. Leonor no resistiría estar de nuevo presa, y Omar le propone huir.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Desesperada, Mónica le pide ayuda a Omar para huir con su hijo, luego de confesarle a doña Alba que Aurelio es culpable de la muerte de Isabel. Morejón acusa a Ignacio del atentado a Monteverde.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Doña Alba reconoce que Aurelio es un criminal y está decidida a matarlo. Leonor se enfrenta a tiros con Mónica frente al edificio de Omar. Feyo y Casillas viajan a Cancún, dispuestos a vengarse.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio encuentra a Luzma drogada y bebiendo sin control. Ella lo culpa, le dice que consume la droga que él vende. Alba le dice a Víctor y Rutila que enviará a Carlitos a Colombia con su tía.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Leonor acepta la propuesta de Omar de convertirse en la señora Terán. Rivero no cree que el agente de la DEA asesinó a Andrews, mientras Morán le dice a Tim que él y los Casillas lo mataron.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Doña Alba amenaza con un arma a Aurelio, y él le pide que lo mate de una vez. Ella no dispara y llama a Feyo para decirle que se cuide. Omar miente, le asegura a Leonor que no conoce a Mónica.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Feyo y Aurelio llegan a Cancún listos para matar. Rutila le confiesa a Rivero que el Chema es el padre de su hijo, y le pide que lo asesine. Begoña consigue drogas en el cuarto de Luciana.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Mónica le revela a Víctor que Aurelio es culpable de la muerte de Isabel y sus hijos, pero él desespera y no quiere creerlo. Feyo acusa a Casillas de soplón, pero dejan su enfrentamiento para luego.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Víctor culpa a Aurelio de la muerte de Chabela y se van a los golpes: le dice a su tío que está con Mónica, que no se atreva a hacerle daño. Feyo y el Chema se asocian y van contra Casillas.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Junto a Esperanza, Aurelio se decide por el lavado de dinero y le deja el narcotráfico a Víctor; además, no perdona a Mónica por revelar su secreto. Cristina venderá información de Casillas a Ignacio.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Ramiro consigue que Aurelio apoye sus planes con Omar para ponerle la mano al poder político, y le revela que Terán y Mónica son primos. Luzma se escapa con el Chef y llegan a casa de Cristina.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Después de una noche de amor con Rutila, el Chema sale de su madriguera para ayudar a Feyo, sin imaginar los planes de Rivero. Mónica convence a Omar para que vaya a la cita con Ramiro Silva.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Omar está aterrado al saber que Ramiro lo escogió para ser presidente de México y que recibirá órdenes de Aurelio. El Chema escapa y hiere a Rivero, mientras Leonor rescata a Rutila y a su hijo.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Los estudiantes son ejecutados por orden de Feyo, quien, junto con el Chema, busca matar a los Casillas. Aurelio entrega su imperio a Mónica y Víctor. Rutila encuentra el dinero para huir.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio le cobra con sangre a Cristina su traición, y la mata frente a Esperanza, mientras le jura a Feyo que se vengará por lo que le hizo a Alba. Tim captura al general venezolano en Aruba.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: En un atentado organizado por Aurelio para levantar la candidatura de Omar, Ignacio mata a Leonor en un acto de campaña. Pasan dos años, la salud de Casillas se deteriora y reúne a su familia.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: El Chema y Feyo atacan a la familia Casillas y Luzma queda gravemente herida. Mónica está embarazada de Víctor, mientras él es víctima de una emboscada en Colombia, traicionado por Tijeras.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Para vengarse de Feyo, Aurelio visita en la cárcel a María Sol y lo llama para que escuche cuando la ahorca. Desesperado, Aguilera advierte que matará a todos los Casillas. Javi salva a Víctor.

programme.title: Dredd
programme.desc: Mega City One is a vast, violent metropolis where felons rule the streets. The only law lies with cops called "judges," who act as judge, jury and executioner, and Dredd (Karl Urban) is one of the city's most feared. One day, Dredd is partnered with Cassandra (Olivia Thirlby), a rookie with powerful psychic abilities. A report of a terrible crime sends Dredd and Cassandra to a dangerous area controlled by Ma-Ma (Lena Headey), a drug lord who will stop at nothing to protect her empire.

programme.title: Conan the Barbarian
programme.desc: A powerful Cimmerian warrior, Conan carves a bloody path across the land of Hyboria on a personal vendetta. That soon turns into an epic battle against evil, for Conan's mortal enemy, Khalar Zym, seeks the legendary Mask of Acheron. The artifact will enable Khalar Zym to raise his wife from the dead and achieve immortality for himself, but it will also unleash a malevolent force upon the land, and only Conan and his companions can stop it.

programme.title: Braven
programme.desc: A logger and his father head to their hunting cabin, hoping for a quiet weekend. Instead, they find themselves in a kill-or-be-killed stand for survival when they encounter a gang of ruthless drug traffickers.

programme.title: Kickboxer
programme.desc: Eric Sloane (Dennis Alexio) is an American kickboxing pro, helped by his brother, Kurt (Jean-Claude Van Damme), in his quest for glory. But when the two go to Thailand to take on legendary Tong Po (Michel Qissi), the opponent viciously beats Eric and leaves him paralyzed. Swearing vengeance, Kurt tracks down master Xian Chow (Dennis Chan) and begins learning the sport himself while also getting caught up in criminal intrigue involving thuggish crime boss Freddy Li (Ka Ting Lee).

programme.title: Kickboxer 2: The Road Back
programme.desc: Asian villains pick fight with L.A. kickboxer (Sasha Mitchell).

programme.title: Righteous Kill
programme.desc: Detectives Thomas Cowan (Robert De Niro) and David Fisk (Al Pacino), 30-year veterans of the NYPD, investigate the murder of a pimp. The crime resembles a case they solved many years earlier. As the body count rises, they realize they're dealing with a vigilante taking over when the police fail. The similarities between past and present crimes leads the detectives to wonder if they put the wrong man behind bars.

programme.title: Alex Cross
programme.desc: Alex Cross (Tyler Perry) works as a detective/psychologist for the Detroit Police Department along with his lifelong friend, Tommy Kane (Edward Burns), and detective Monica Ashe (Rachel Nichols). Cross' latest case puts him on a collision course with Picasso (Matthew Fox), a cunning serial killer whose ultimate target is multinational industrialist Giles Mercier (Jean Reno). Cross must find a way inside Picasso's head not only to catch the killer but also to stem the violent urges Cross feels.

programme.title: City of Lies
programme.desc: Los Angeles Police Department detective Russell Poole has spent years trying to solve his biggest case -- the murders of The Notorious B.I.G. and Tupac Shakur -- but after two decades, the investigation remains open. Jack Jackson, a reporter desperate to save his reputation and career, is determined to find out why. In search of the truth, the two team up and unravel a growing web of institutional corruption and lies.

programme.title: Damaged
programme.desc: When a sadistic murderer surfaces in Scotland, terrified local authorities call on a Chicago detective who investigated a killing spree with the same horrific pattern five years earlier.

programme.desc: To get back in the good graces of her murderous boss (Bruce Willis), a seductive thief (Claire Forlani) recruits an ex-lover (Mark-Paul Gosselaar) to steal rare and valuable gems.

programme.desc: Elite spy Orson Fortune must track down and stop the sale of a deadly new weapons technology wielded by billionaire arms broker Greg Simmonds. Reluctantly teamed up with some of the world's best operatives, Fortune and his crew recruit Hollywood's biggest movie star, Danny Francesco, to help them on their globe-trotting mission to save the world.

programme.title: Kick-Ass
programme.desc: Using his love for comics as inspiration, teenager Dave Lizewski (Aaron Johnson) decides to reinvent himself as a superhero -- despite a complete lack of special powers. Dave dons a costume, dubs himself "Kick-Ass," and gets to work fighting crime. He joins forces with the father/daughter vigilante team of Big Daddy and Hit Girl, then befriends another fledgling crime-fighter called Red Mist (Christopher Mintz-Plasse), but a scheming mobster soon puts their alliance to the test.

programme.title: Borderlands
programme.desc: Returning to her home planet Pandora, an infamous bounty hunter forms an unexpected alliance with a ragtag team of misfits. Together, they battle alien monsters and dangerous bandits to uncover one of Pandora's most explosive secrets.

programme.title: Detroit
programme.desc: In the summer of 1967, rioting and civil unrest starts to tear apart the city of Detroit. Two days later, a report of gunshots prompts the Detroit Police Department, the Michigan State Police and the Michigan Army National Guard to search and seize an annex of the nearby Algiers Motel. Several policemen start to flout procedure by forcefully and viciously interrogating guests to get a confession. By the end of the night, three unarmed men are gunned down while several others are brutally beaten.

programme.title: Catch .44
programme.desc: The plan of three women (Malin Akerman, Nikki Reed, Deborah Ann Woll) to intercept a drug shipment for their boss (Bruce Willis) goes horribly wrong.

programme.title: American Heist
programme.desc: Within 24 hours of being released from a 10-year sentence, Frankie (Adrien Brody) threatens to drag his brother James (Hayden Christensen) back into the criminal underworld that nearly swallowed them both years before.

programme.title: Abduction
programme.desc: For many years, Nathan Harper (Taylor Lautner) has had the uneasy feeling that life with his family isn't quite what it seems. His fears come true when he finds a picture of himself as a youngster on a missing-persons website, proof that the people he's called mom and dad his whole life are not his real parents. As he draws close to uncovering his true identity, Nathan becomes the target of assassins, forcing him to flee with his neighbor, Karen (Lily Collins), the only person he can now trust.

programme.title: The Hunger Games
programme.desc: In what was once North America, the Capitol of Panem maintains its hold on its 12 districts by forcing them each to select a boy and a girl, called Tributes, to compete in a nationally televised event called the Hunger Games. Every citizen must watch as the youths fight to the death until only one remains. District 12 Tribute Katniss Everdeen (Jennifer Lawrence) has little to rely on, other than her hunting skills and sharp instincts, in an arena where she must weigh survival against love.

programme.title: The Hunger Games: Catching Fire
programme.desc: After arriving safely home from their unprecedented victory in the 74th Annual Hunger Games, Katniss Everdeen (Jennifer Lawrence) and Peeta Mellark (Josh Hutcherson) discover that they must do a quick turnaround and begin a Victors Tour. As she and Peeta travel throughout the districts, Katniss senses a rebellion is stirring. However, President Snow (Donald Sutherland) proves that he is still very much in control when word comes of a cruel change in the rules for the upcoming 75th Hunger Games.

programme.title: The Hunger Games: Mockingjay, Part 1
programme.desc: Following her rescue from the devastating Quarter Quell, Katniss (Jennifer Lawrence) awakes in the complex beneath the supposedly destroyed District 13. Her home, District 12, has been reduced to rubble, and Peeta Mellark (Josh Hutcherson) is now the brainwashed captive of President Snow (Donald Sutherland). At the same time, Katniss also learns about a secret rebellion spreading throughout all of Panem -- a rebellion that will place her at the center of a plot to turn the tables on Snow.

programme.title: The Hunger Games: Mockingjay, Part 2
programme.desc: Realizing the stakes are no longer just for survival, Katniss Everdeen (Jennifer Lawrence) teams up with her closest friends, including Peeta (Josh Hutcherson), Gale (Liam Hemsworth) and Finnick for the ultimate mission. Together, they leave District 13 to liberate the citizens of war-torn Panem and assassinate President Snow, who's obsessed with destroying Katniss. What lies ahead are mortal traps, dangerous enemies and moral choices that will ultimately determine the future of millions.

programme.title: The Condemned
programme.desc: Jack Conrad is a death-row inmate awaiting execution in a Central American jail when a TV producer buys him and takes him to a remote island. There, Jack and nine other prisoners learn they are to fight each other to the death, with freedom as the prize for the sole survivor. The producer plans to broadcast the event live and uncensored over the Internet.

programme.title: The Condemned 2
programme.desc: A former bounty hunter (Randy Orton) lands in a tournament where convicts fight to the death for an online audience.

programme.title: Dig
programme.desc: Held hostage by a dangerous couple, a widower and his daughter must work together to outsmart their captors and survive the night.

programme.title: Braven
programme.desc: A logger and his father head to their hunting cabin, hoping for a quiet weekend. Instead, they find themselves in a kill-or-be-killed stand for survival when they encounter a gang of ruthless drug traffickers.

programme.title: Divergent
programme.desc: Tris Prior lives in a futuristic world in which society is divided into five factions. As each person enters adulthood, he or she must choose a faction and commit to it for life. Tris chooses Dauntless -- those who pursue bravery above all else. However, her initiation leads to the discovery that she is a Divergent and will never be able to fit into just one faction. Warned that she must conceal her status, Tris uncovers a looming war which threatens everyone she loves.

programme.title: The Divergent Series: Insurgent
programme.desc: Now on the run from Jeanine and the rest of the power-hungry Erudites, Tris and Four search for allies and answers in the ruins of Chicago. They must find out what Tris' family sacrificed their lives to protect and why the Erudites will do anything to stop them. Side by side, Tris and Four face one seemingly insurmountable challenge after another, as they unravel the secrets of the past and -- ultimately -- the future of their world.

programme.title: The Divergent Series: Allegiant
programme.desc: Tris escapes with Four to journey beyond the wall that encloses Chicago. For the first time, they leave the only city and family they have ever known to find a peaceful solution. Once outside, they learn shocking new truths that render old discoveries meaningless. As the ruthless battle threatens humanity, Tris and Four quickly decide who to trust to survive. Tris must ultimately make difficult choices about courage, allegiance, sacrifice and love.

programme.desc: After serving 28 years in prison for accidentally killing the son of a crime boss, newly paroled gangster Val (Al Pacino) reunites with his former partners in crime, Doc (Christopher Walken) and Hirsch (Alan Arkin), for a night on the town. As the three men revisit old haunts, reflect on their glory days and try to make up for lost time, one wrestles with a terrible quandary: Doc has orders to kill Val, and time is running out for him to figure out a way out of his dilemma.

programme.title: The Hard Word
programme.desc: Out of prison after serving time for armed robbery, brothers Dale (Guy Pearce), Mal (Damien Richardson) and Shane (Joel Edgerton) are set for a bank heist planned by their underhanded lawyer, Frank (Robert Taylor). But after pocketing his share of the cash, Frank, who's bedding Dale's wife (Rachel Griffiths), arranges to have them incarcerated again. Though he understands what his attorney is up to, Dale and his brothers agree to pull off a final robbery if Frank can get them freed once more.

Jackson) and a man who claims to be a sheriff. Hoping to find shelter from a blizzard, the group travels to a stagecoach stopover located on a mountain pass. Greeted there by four strangers, the eight travelers soon learn that they may not make it to their destination after all.

programme.title: Jackie Brown
programme.desc: When flight attendant Jackie Brown (Pam Grier) is busted smuggling money for her arms dealer boss, Ordell Robbie (Samuel L. Jackson), agent Ray Nicolette (Michael Keaton) and detective Mark Dargus (Michael Bowen) want her help to bring down Robbie. Facing jail time for her silence or death for her cooperation, Brown decides instead to double-cross both parties and make off with the smuggled money. Meanwhile, she enlists the help of bondsman Max Cherry (Robert Forster), a man who loves her.

programme.title: Kill Bill: Vol. 1
programme.desc: A former assassin, known simply as The Bride (Uma Thurman), wakes from a coma four years after her jealous ex-lover Bill (David Carradine) attempts to murder her on her wedding day. Fueled by an insatiable desire for revenge, she vows to get even with every person who contributed to the loss of her unborn child, her entire wedding party, and four years of her life. After devising a hit list, The Bride sets off on her quest, enduring unspeakable injury and unscrupulous enemies.

programme.title: Kill Bill: Vol. 2
programme.desc: The Bride (Uma Thurman) picks up where she left off in volume one with her quest to finish the hit list she has composed of all the people who have wronged her, including ex-boyfriend Bill (David Carradine), who tried to have her killed four years ago during her wedding to another man. Leaving several dead in her wake, she eventually tracks down Bill in Mexico. Using skills she has learned during her assassin career, she attempts to finish what she set out to do in the first place.

programme.title: Raw Deal
programme.desc: When efforts to prosecute mob boss Luigi Patrovita are repeatedly derailed thanks to a mole in the FBI, the only choice is to bring in an outsider -- specifically, Mark Kaminsky, a disgraced agent who leaps at a chance for reinstatement. After FBI chief Shannon gives him his orders, Kaminsky fakes his death and reemerges as an ex-con named Brenner. Undercover and accountable to no one, the former Fed tears up the mob from the inside.

programme.title: Manhunter
programme.desc: FBI criminal profiler Will Graham (William Petersen) is called out of early retirement to assist on a serial murder case involving a killer known as the "Tooth Fairy" (Tom Noonan). Graham enlists the help of imprisoned serial killer -- and cannibal -- Dr. Hannibal Lecter (Brian Cox), who is the reason Graham took an early retirement. Soon, Graham and the FBI are entangled in a deadly cat-and-mouse game between the Tooth Fairy, Lecter and an interfering journalist (Stephen Lang).

programme.title: Bad Lieutenant
programme.desc: The Lieutenant (Harvey Keitel) is a corrupt cop steeped in gambling debt who exploits his authority to sexually harass teenage girls, embezzle money and abuse drugs. His troubles come to a head when a mob lackey delivers an ultimatum: pay off his debt, or else. His fate appears sealed. But when The Lieutenant learns that a $50,000 reward is being offered to whoever catches a pair of thugs who raped a nun (Frankie Thorn), he jumps at the opportunity, hoping that he can still redeem himself.

Complicating John's life further is a series of drug-related murders that has the police pegging him as a suspect.
